headings: DWP Jobseeker's Allowance AI Deep-Dive Pack
text: DEFONEOS — DWP Jobseeker's Allowance AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × JSA DWP Jobseeker's Allowance AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK JSA — New Style (contribution-based) and income-based unemployment benefit. Claimant commitment, work search conditions, sanctions regime, Universal Credit migration. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Eligibility Eligibility — NI Contributions, Residence, Age New Style JSA requires Class 1 NI contributions in last 2 complete tax years (26 weeks at or above LEL). Aged 18-SPA. Not in full-time education. Available for and actively seeking work. Income-based JSA being replaced by UC. Habitual residence test. Right to work in UK. Claimant Commitment Claimant Commitment — Work-Related Requirements Claimant commitment sets conditions: work search, availability, work preparation. Three tiers: all work-related requirements, work-focused interview only, no requirements. Tailored to claimant circumstances — health, caring, age. Signed agreement. Breach = sanction risk. Digital claimant commitment. Work Search Work Search Conditions — 35 Hours/Week, Activities 35 hours/week work search. CV, applications, networking, interviews, skills. Jobcentre Plus advisor support. Universal Jobmatch. Work search review every 2 weeks. Flexible support for carers, disabled, over-50s. Work search journal. Employer contact evidence. Skills gap analysis. Sanctions Sanctions Regime — Low, Medium, High Level Low-level: 1-13 weeks (failure to attend, incomplete job search). Medium-level: 4-26 weeks (failure to apply, refusing work). High-level: up to 156 weeks (voluntary resignation, misconduct). Hardship payments available. MR and appeal rights. Sanctions rate ~3% of JSA caseload. Mandatory reconsideration before appeal. Payments Payment Rates — Weekly JSA, UC Standard Allowance New Style JSA: under-25 £71.70/wk, 25+ £90.50/wk (2026 rates). Paid fortnightly. 6-month duration for New Style (contribution-based). Income-based replaced by UC. UC standard allowance: under-25 £311.68/mo, 25+ £393.45/mo. UC work allowance taper. JSA and UC interaction — cannot claim both simultaneously. UC Transition Universal Credit Migration — Legacy to UC Income-based JSA migrating to UC via managed migration. Transitional protection payments. Natural migration via change of circumstances. Gateway conditions. SDP transitional element. Severe disability premium. Carer element. Migration notice issued by DWP. 3-month deadline to claim UC. TP erodes over time. Restart Scheme Restart Scheme — Intensive Support, 12 Months Restart Scheme for 12+ months unemployed. Intensive employment support. Provider-led — Maximus, SERCO, Reed. Placement history. Skills assessment. Work experience. Employer engagement. Referral from JCP advisor. Claimant can request alternative provider. Provider performance monitoring. Youth Youth Employment — Kickstart, Youth Offer, Traineeships 18-24 youth employment support. Youth Obligation — enhanced claimant commitment for 18-21. Traineeships. Apprenticeships. Sector-based work academies. Youth Hub in JCP. Youth employment advisor. DWP/DfE integration. NEET data sharing. Careers advice. Digital skills bootcamps. Over-50s Over-50s Employment — Midlife MOT, Experience Corps Over-50s tailored support. Midlife MOT — health, skills, finances. Experience Corps volunteer mentoring. Flexible working expectations. Pension awareness. Age-positive employer engagement. Skills assessment for career changers. Redundancy support. Part-time work consideration. Carer-friendly claimant commitment. Fraud Fraud and Error — Overpayments, Detection, Recovery JSA fraud rate ~3.2%. Overpayment detection via PAYE data cross-check. CIS/RTI real-time earnings matching. Investigation officer
